building.relocated_from: 1356-62 Scott Street, at the corner of O'Farrell Street

historical_record.description: The pair of two-storey Italianate flats now at 1239-45 Scott Street was moved here from the corner of Scott and O'Farrell streets, about 1974-76.

Still standing at 1356-62 Scott Street, on the corner of O'Farrell Street, the pair held two flats each; Redevelopment Agency inspectors rated both exteriors fair, the interiors fair, and the street fronts of notable visual merit.
